subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I can't __hearing what__ he's saying.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb "**hearing**" used after "can't".
 
• The correct form should be "**hear**" since **"can't" **requires the base form of the verb.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**hear what**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I can't **hear what **he's saying."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **hears what** – The form "hears" is incorrect after "can't".
 
• **heard what** – The form "heard" is incorrect after "can't".
 
• **hear what** – **The correct form after "can't".**
